design_authority: docs/us_short_system_design.md §4.2 (catalyst: 8-K/订单/产品/监管/LLM 语义 — 新闻事件) / §5.1b (news 类: 正式做空报告/欺诈指控 = advisory-first) / §3.1 (provenance) / §3.5 (发布时刻与 as_of 是不同 PIT 事实; 不用 look-ahead) / §18.2 (跨模块契约先 schema-first 冻结再消费)
authorization_note: OFFLINE contract SHAPE only. Live Massive fetch + runner wiring stay gated under SR-PROVIDER-001. Reachability + real shape proven 2026-07-01 (docs/us_short_cut5_pass2_feasibility_probe_summary_20260701.json + captured gitignored raw): Massive/Polygon /v2/reference/news returns a list of items each {id, published_utc, publisher{name,...}, title, article_url, tickers[], insights[{ticker, sentiment, sentiment_reasoning}], description, author, keywords, image_url}. `insights` carries PER-TICKER sentiment ∈ {positive, negative, neutral} (10/10 sampled records had it), so a structured sentiment tally needs NO LLM. This binding freezes the shape a producer must honor; it selects no provider and authorizes no fetch/DataHub/production/ship-gate.
recency_window_basis: calendar days before as_of. News is time-sensitive (decays faster than filings/grades), so a TIGHTER 30-day recent-news window than the 90-day offering/grades window. Reviewed calibration prior, NOT validated alpha; change = reviewed schema + binding version bump.
sentiment_note: PER-TICKER sentiment is taken from the `insights` entry whose ticker == the (canonical) ticker. A news item with NO matching ticker-specific insight, or a sentiment value outside {positive, negative, neutral}, yields `unknown` — never a fabricated positive/negative. Massive/Polygon's OWN insights sentiment drives it; there is NO LLM in this offline slice (the §5.1b semantic reasoning / advisory escalation stays a later, gated layer — title/url/reasoning are carried for it).
ticker_coverage_rule: the (canonical) ticker MUST appear in the item's canonicalized `tickers` list; otherwise the item was mis-attributed to this ticker and fails closed (mirrors the fmp-grades symbol cross-check).

summary_contract.note: the §4.2 recent-news catalyst intensity + a per-ticker sentiment tally from Massive's own insights (net_sentiment > 0 = net-positive coverage; a cluster of negative items is the §5.1b advisory trigger for a later read).

pit_rule: each item's `published_utc` (tz-aware RFC3339) normalized to its ET calendar date must be <= as_of; a future item is EXCLUDED (look-ahead, §3.5); an item older than recency_window_days is OUT-OF-WINDOW (counted, not in the summary). A malformed published_utc (not tz-aware RFC3339) fails closed (raise).

emission_fitness.note: only a full-coverage clean-parse ticker emits a news signal; partial / missing / failed / degraded -> excluded. A full/ok ticker with ZERO in-window items emits NO signal (no recent news = neutral; the consumer defaults neutral per §4.2 缺分量中性).

date_format: as_of = YYYY-MM-DD (ASCII, real-calendar); published_utc + observed_at = tz-aware RFC3339 date-time
consumer_note: Produces the §4.2 recent-news catalyst FACT + a per-ticker sentiment tally (from Massive's own insights) + the §5.1b advisory basis (title / article_url / sentiment_reasoning for a later LLM/human read). The source itself does NOT score; bounded catalyst projection lives in engine/us_short_massive_news_catalyst.py. Deeper §5.1b LLM/human adverse-news review remains a later gated layer.

duplicate_policy.note: the Massive news item `id` is the source-row identity (carried into each output record for reverse-lookup); a repeated id fails closed (never double-counted into news_count/net_sentiment). publisher_name is normalized (whitespace-collapsed + casefold) so `Pub`/` pub `/`PUB` are ONE publisher in distinct_publishers.

checked_empty_note: a full-coverage clean-parse ticker with ZERO in-window news items emits a CHECKED coverage record (disposition checked_no_recent_news) retaining its provenance — DISTINCT from a never-queried ticker (§3.3). Downstream defaults neutral either way, but the audit distinction is retained.
